scope: Replace the Settings screen with an anchored context menu and compact autosaving bottom sheets; remove Settings-only eCampus controls and helpers.
coverage_note: 83 related tests passed after the final dropdown layout fix. A mounted guard was then added to the parent settings callback; the affected 3 menu/capture tests and 6 shell tests passed again. They overlap with the 83 tests and are not additive.
earlier_runs_note: Intermediate failures are preserved. Initial popup tests used an ambiguous label finder; later retries exposed snackbar visibility/queuing and a stale slider coordinate after an error changed sheet height. Final passing runs are listed separately.

analysis.capture_method: Exact stdout copied from direct flutter analyze --no-pub tool output

behavior.notification_toggle: Existing defaultNotificationEnabled for new tasks; enabling requests existing notification permission; no bulk change to existing Task reminders.
behavior.swipe: Two sections (tasks, trash), two direction selectors each. Saves on selection, using latest settings and replacing only one direction.
behavior.sliders: Existing notification offsets (minutes) and urgent 1..14 days. Drag updates display; release saves. No Apply/Save/Cancel buttons.
behavior.errors: Failed save retains last saved value and allows retry. Sheets show only error feedback; popup toggle reports failure through existing snackbar pattern.
behavior.dismissal: Standard outside touch, back and drag dismissal; committed changes persist.
behavior.preserved: Saved home period/view and hidden list/tag preferences, Task CRUD, notification service, calendar/widget handlers.

ecampus_note: Only parent Settings display/session listener/manual cleanup code was removed. Import progress still owns login/logout/session/cookie cleanup. 22 existing eCampus tests use mock login/HTTP, not a real school account.
